'''Algaz Station''' is a [[dwarven]] outpost in [[Loch Modan]] where many dwarven mountaineers are stationed. It is located just east if the [[North Gate Pass]], and south of [[Dun Algaz]], from which it takes its name. [[Mountaineer Stormpike]] can be found here, as well as an armorer named [[Gothor Brumn]].
